description: Classifies Forgevia managed assets by cross-platform sharing strategy. shared/ is the single hand-edited source rendered to assets/codex and assets/claude by scripts/sync-platform-assets.mjs. platformSpecific entries are kept per-platform with a recorded reason. sharedSemantics are cross-platform invariants enforced by --check even on platformSpecific assets, so non-platform meaning (e.g. openspec generatedBy) cannot silently drift.

platformSpecific.reason: Router embeds divergent controller mechanisms: Codex spawn_agent/wait_agent/list_agents polling vs Claude native Task lifecycle, plus a phase-verification clause carried only by Codex.
Initialization guidance differs in framing (--tools recommendation wording) beyond a plain path token.
Prose references the platform by label ('Codex/Claude environment') in full sentences, not only path variables.
Same platform-label sentence pattern as forgevia-doctor.
User-selection step uses AskUserQuestion only on Claude via a sentence-level rewrite.
AskUserQuestion prompt and progress-tracking (TodoWrite vs client mechanism) differ at sentence level.
Spec-sync step is described differently (openspec flow vs Task-invoked openspec-sync-specs).
Explores are invoked differently (/opsx: prefix on Claude) and ASCII/table formatting differs.
Codex carries a config.toml + sandbox flag block and codex.emitImage() calls; Claude uses environment-generic enablement and emitImage(). NOTICE.txt also differs.

Overlay targets the upstream superpowers install root. Continuous-controller and child-agent lifecycle diverge (Codex spawn_agent/wait_agent/list_agents polling vs Claude native Task lifecycle); the model-selection section is conditional on Codex but unconditional on Claude. Byte-identical siblings (brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, test-driven-development) are rendered from assets/shared/superpowers/skills/.
Overlay targets the upstream superpowers install root. code-reviewer.md frontmatter carries an explicit-model directive only on Claude; Codex omits it.
